chinese: 民之饥，以其上食税之多，是以饥。
民之难治，以其上之有为，是以难治。
民之轻死，以其上求生之厚，是以轻死。
夫唯无以生为者，是贤于贵生。
pinyin: Mín zhī jī， yǐ qí shàng shí shuì zhī duō， shì yǐ jī。
Mín zhī nán zhì， yǐ qí shàng zhī yǒu wèi， shì yǐ nán zhì。
Mín zhī qīng sǐ， yǐ qí shàng qiú shēng zhī hòu， shì yǐ qīng sǐ。
Fū wéi wú yǐ shēng wèi zhě， shì xián yú guì shēng。
english: When people go hungry, the government's taxes are too high. When people become rebellious, the government has become too intrusive.
When people begin to view death lightly, wealthy people have too much which causes others to starve.
Only those who do not cling to their life can save it.
